newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon to build 30 bln yen photocopy chemical plant.
newsitem.headline: Canon to build 30 bln yen photocopy chemical plant.

text.p: Canon Inc said on Friday that it would spend 30 billion yen to build a new plant in Oita prefecture, southern Japan, in 1998 for the production of photocopy chemicals.
A company spokesman said that the new factory will produce chemical products for copying machines and printers, including toner and photosensitive drums.
The factory is expected to start operation in April 1999, he said.
Canon currently operates six chemical-product plants in Japan and five abroad.
The company said in a statement that it decided to build the new plant in response to increased production of its printers and photocopiers.
